claims.claim: Prospective safe pages reside in the original immutable FAILURE artifact tree. Readers authenticate exact TASK revision, RUN, candidate, FAILURE digests, ordered command, source, manifest and page identities through Git.

Page requests return at most 32 allowlisted views in source order, preserve distinct parameterized identity digests, and provide deterministic range, next-selector, exhaustion and truncation semantics.

Paged population counts require complete, stable structured observations. Text and incomplete observations retain partial coverage and count limitations; unsupported or uncertain summaries produce typed blockers without PASS assertions.

Readers reject mismatched subjects, changed refs, forged or stale selectors, invalid ranges, and missing or malformed projections. Existing private-detail owner and original-digest gates and historical FAILURE decoding remain preserved.

Pages withhold parameters, captures, tracebacks and native output. Portable paging snapshots and Brain contexts redact checkout roots and retain NON_PASS_DIAGNOSTIC semantics without verification or completion authority.

Safe-detail V3 supports 10000 failures while V1/V2 retain their 4096 ceiling. Scale fixtures cover 33, 64, 1000 and 10000 failures with finite resource assertions; the 10000-node implementation-local case completed all 313 pages within those assertions.

Brain Sync discovers page selectors and accepts later-page requests through the existing Git artifact reader. Brain contexts fingerprint the selected page without creating RUNs, invoking verification, changing lifecycle authority or rewriting historical artifacts.
